messages:
Arun: Heads-up team — rolling out OnPrem Data Residency Toggle + Minimal Telemetry Guardrails v1.0 tonight. Goal: let customers pin telemetry to a region and enable the absolutely-minimal envelope when required. Rollout window and short prep below. :loudspeaker:
release-bot: Artifact pushed: residency-guardrails@v1.0 -> s3://internal-releases/residency/guardrails/v1.0. Window: 2025-11-03 02:00 UTC -> 2025-11-03 06:00 UTC. Canary: 8% for first 45m.
Selene: Quick confirm  default for new on-prem tenants?
Arun: Default residency = customer's configured region; telemetry = OFF (minimal). Customers can opt-in to telemetry and choose retention (7/30/90 days). We record a signed attestation when they opt in.
support: Support rota for window: @Selene and @Ravi (backup: @Maya). Escalate agent registration or key access failures to #eng-oncall.
Arun: Customer readiness checklist:
- Ensure management port TCP/15013 is reachable (new management port for this release; runtime still on 15011).
- If using HSM, confirm KMS credentials and CA thumbprint ahead of time.
- Decide residency region and telemetry retention; record choice in onboarding doc.
- Run residency preflight and attach output to ticket.
CLI example to enable residency and minimal telemetry via rwinfctl:
```
rwinfctl tenant configure --tenant-id=acme-123 --residency=eu-west-1 --telemetry=minimal --retention=7d
```
docs-bot: Docs PR merged for the residency toggle and minimal envelope spec. Link: https://internal.docs/residency/v1.0 (will update customer FAQ after rollout).
Selene: Security/compliance note: minimal telemetry only ships aggregated counters and a hashed metric map; no raw prompts or user identifiers. Attestation bundle includes timestamp, tenant id, and signed policy id. Default retention for attestations is 365 days.
Arun: No cert rotations required. New management port (15013) is the only network change. I'll post customer email and FAQ snippets in #customer-communications after this thread. Monitoring: 5h post-rollout. Thanks all. :rocket:
